_note: Args used for the Okemo trace pass with the trailmap-trace workflow, before the review (5 readers, 22 trails): the 9 trails printed with no line (not glades), the 10 medium/low proposals, both halves of the Tomahawk split, and Mountain Road / Fast Track, whose boundaries with Lower Mountain Road / Inn Bound were uncertain. Paths were a scratch dir; use your own.
resort: Okemo Mountain Resort, Vermont, 2025-26 winter map
legend: Trail difficulty = the color of the drawn trail line (green / blue / black) and the symbol printed with the name (green circle, blue square, black diamond, two black diamonds). Trail names are capital text in the trail's own color with a white halo. Orange lines with an orange pill and an orange name are terrain parks. Glades are shaded bands (blue-violet or dark grey) with a tree icon; lines inside a band belong to that glade. Red lines are lifts and carpets (short red lines with a numbered red circle); the brown looping line near Jackson Gore is the Timber Ripper coaster. Yellow shaded areas = slow zones; salmon areas = closed; grey hatching = race areas; light-green bands = family learning zones; lilac dots = ski school areas; yellow smiley icons = kids adventure zones (not trails). Grey winding lines on the lower slopes are roads and condo streets. Some trails are printed only as a name and symbol on an open slope or connector, with no drawn line.
